scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory-products report and audited export

criteria.description: The catalog, permission boundary, filters, grain, exact eight-field row contract and explicit non-promotion exclusions are implemented and covered.
criteria.limitations: The report requires inventory.read in addition to the existing billing.read Reports Workbench gate; this additive baseline is explicit and unchanged. Vetus evidence does not expose an authoritative dynamic-executor schema.

criteria.description: The inventory repository/service use only tenant-scoped persisted inventory_items, parameterized SQL, escaped literal search, inclusive UTC date boundaries, deterministic ordering and fail-closed limits.
criteria.limitations: The source is intentionally limited to current persisted item facts; lots, movements, historical/as-of stock and valuation are excluded. Disposable PostgreSQL does not certify target grants or scale.

criteria.description: The API validates execution and export bodies, enforces the existing Reports permission plus the definition permission, maps the exact row shape, and delegates execution/export/audit to ReportsService.
criteria.limitations: This local route gate does not authorize fiscal writes, external providers, scheduled delivery or target operations.

criteria.description: The Reports Workbench consumes the server execution, exports the server artifact, does not load local inventory/lots for this report, validates the exact row contract and renders persisted dates in UTC.
criteria.limitations: Browser evidence is local and disposable; it does not certify production browser policy, accessibility acceptance or deployed assets.

criteria.description: Real disposable PostgreSQL integration and the official authenticated browser runner prove tenant isolation, filters, ordering, overflow detection, server execution, export and audit behavior.
criteria.limitations: The proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL/Redis and does not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, continuous workers or production operations.

criteria.description: TDD, focused regression, workspace coverage, builds, static/security validators, formatting and index hygiene remain within the repository bar.
criteria.limitations: Coverage uses the repository's designated integration exclusions. Remote CI, target operations, external homologation, production and release acceptance remain open.

criteria.description: A fresh read-only independent re-review confirmed both remediation findings are closed and returned bounded approval without a CRITICAL, HIGH or MEDIUM finding.
criteria.limitations: Approval is limited to this bounded local slice and is not a global ERP or production approval.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, general Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General Vetus parity remains 4/11 verified, clinical parity 2/3 and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: Exact Vetus dynamic-executor columns, filters and grain remain unverified.
The report is a current persisted inventory_items snapshot only; historical/as-of stock, lots, movements, valuation and scheduled worker delivery remain open.
Disposable local services do not certify target RLS/roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, Redis operations, remote CI, accessibility, operational LGPD, providers, production or release acceptance.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped on-demand read/export of persisted inventory_items with the exact eight-field contract.
Keep the existing billing.read Reports Workbench baseline and additive inventory.read definition permission; revalidate before changing the access model.
Revalidate before adding scheduled delivery, historical/as-of semantics, valuation, lot/movement inference, writes, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release scope.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory-products report/export
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository, API and SPA implementation with focused tests and disposable PostgreSQL verification using only tenant-scoped persisted inventory_items. Exclude scheduled worker resolution, historical/as-of stock, derived valuation, providers, fiscal writes, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding scheduled delivery, historical/valuation semantics, writes, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release activity.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED; select the next gap only through fresh scouting and a new implementation-ready authority.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory item schema, report grain, persisted source ordering or access baseline
Changes to report execution/export/audit, scheduled resolution, historical stock or valuation
Expansion to providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill or release action
